notes.title: Dumbriel Patch (Playtest v0.2)
notes.notes:
General Updates compared to (Playtest v0.1)


 Performance improved, doubling FPS.
 Keyboard and gamepad remapping added in settings.
 Haptic feedback was added for gamepads.
 Graphic settings added.
 Display and color settings added.
 Audio and SFX levels are now adjustable in settings.
 Save system implemented.
 Four new crafting materials were added: Demon's Eye, Mushroom, Bone, and Empty Jar.
 Five new craftable potions were added: Life Steal, Counterspell, Fury Surge, Reincarnation, and Resource Recovery.
 Only one potion effect can be active at a time. Using a skill while under a potion's effect will combine their effects.
 New VFXs and skill improvements were added.
 Health and mana bars updated.
 Skills section has been added, and ability keys can now be reassigned.
 Multiple language support added.
 Boss fight and heaven level were removed from the main menu.
 Enemy and spike colliders fixed.
 Sound effects are balanced.
 New skill added.


Skills

 Soul Leech Dumbriel shifts into a tiny particle and leaps into an enemy’s body to deal damage.


Crafting Materials

 Bone
 Empty Jar
 Mushroom
 Demon's Eye
 Fury Surge


Craftable Potions 

 Fury Surge (new) Sword’s attack power and speed are increased for 10 sec

 Counterspell (new) Partially blocks and reflects all incoming damage for 10 sec

 Life Steal (new) Gain vampirism effect and restore health when striking enemies for 5 sec.

 Reincarnation (new) Revive after death with 25% health and 25% energy.

 Resource Recovery (new) Recover lost health and energy from the last three seconds.


Combat Adjustments & Enemies

 Removed enemy pushback on sword strikes.
 Enemy animations now slow down when taking damage.
 Dumbriel's combo attacks added.
 Dumbriel can perform a Fatality attack after building up enough combo.
 Using an upward strike, Dumbriel can launch an enemy into the air (certain enemies and bosses are immune).
 New enemy blocking system added: Standard Attack (blockable), Yellow Attack (partially blockable), and Red Attack (unblockable).
 Improved feedback when Dumbriel takes damage.
 Enemy health bars now appear for a several seconds when they take damage.


Enemies and Boss

 Flying Demon (new)

 Throws tridents from a distance.
 Stays in the air and never lands.
 Only attacks within a specific zone and stops attacking if the player leaves its zone.
 Can be killed using ranged attacks or specific skills.

 Skeleton Enemy (new)

 New combo attack added after its first strike. If dodged, the second strike does not trigger.

 Dino Enemy (new)

 Throws poison projectiles that explode on impact.
Attacks using its tail, dealing physical damage.

 Bomber (new)

 No longer self-destructs on proximity. Instead, it now throws bombs normally.
New enrage phase added.
During the enrage phase, it can be bounced back with a shield bash, causing it to explode on impact.

__________________________

More updates coming soon! 🚀
